35:222.en: 「While I'm at it, take this too!」

35:381.en: 「I've got no use for small fry! Move!」

35:453.en: 「Earth is ours! I won't let someone\nfrom another star do as they please!」

35:522.en: 「If you came from the stars,\nI'll turn you into a star!」

35:624.en: 「What a foul scent...!\nBut all I can do is fight!」

35:673.en: 「If you get in my way,\nI show no mercy to anyone!」

35:724.en: 「Apologize in the afterlife to those\nsacrificed for your ambition!」

35:787.en: 「I'll never forgive you for\ntoying with people's lives!」

35:1201.en: 「You've done it now!\nIt's my turn this time!」

35:1250.en: 「The great $$アポロ$$ doesn't just\nstand there and take it!」

35:1299.en: 「Time for me to pay you back!」

35:1328.en: 「Damn you for getting in my way!」

35:1353.en: 「I've got to do it to survive!」

35:1427.en: 「Mess with me and you'll get hurt!」

35:1460.en: 「If that's what you want, no mercy!」

35:1499.en: 「If a hit like that could win,\nwe wouldn't be struggling!」

35:1573.en: 「I'll do it!\nYou stand back and watch!」

35:1618.en: 「Watch out! Get out of the way!」

35:1651.en: 「What are you spacing out for!\nYou'll get taken down!」

35:1700.en: 「I won't let you have your way!」

35:1814.en: 「I'll hit them square on the nose!」

35:1845.en: 「Tch! So I wasted too many shots!?」

35:2005.en: 「I can't get a shot from there!」

35:2032.en: 「I don't care if it's cheap,\njust hurry up and find them!」

35:2291.en: 「What's wrong? Hit me if you can!」

35:2353.en: 「Don't worry, $$シルヴィア$$!\nIt won't hit us!」

35:2402.en: 「Impressive, $$シリウス$$...\nI can't fall behind either!」

35:2449.en: 「Like I'll take a hit from\nevery small fry's attack!」

35:2703.en: 「No need to dodge this weak attack!」

35:2740.en: 「You're too weak to pick\na fight with me!」

35:2785.en: 「Tch!\nNo time to bother with small fry!」

35:2830.en: 「That won't work on\nour $$アクエリオン$$!」

35:2875.en: 「It grazed the leg!?\nAre you okay, $$シリウス$$!」

35:3023.en: 「You did it now!\nI'll pay you back for that!」

35:3315.en: 「Getting pushed this far by\n$$ケルビム兵$$s...!」

35:3417.en: 「Damn!\nI can't do a thing against this!?」

35:3524.en: 「That's all you've got...!?\nIt didn't hurt at all...!!」

35:3646.en: 「Heh... I don't give up easily...!\nI'll struggle to the very end!!」

35:3719.en: 「Not yet! I'm not giving up\nuntil the very end!!」

35:3837.en: 「Don't worry, $$シルヴィア$$...!\nI'm never going to lose!」

35:3896.en: 「If $$シリウス$$ says so, it's right...!\nToo early to go reckless, huh...!」

35:4424.en: 「$$アポロ$$!\nLet's settle this with our hands!」

35:4639.en: 「Ngh! I won't be beaten by this!」

35:4713.en: 「I-I'm fine, $$アポロ$$!\nDon't worry about me and fight!」

35:4893.en: 「Right! Don't lump me in with $$アポロ$$!」

35:4932.en: 「Big Brother! You said resets were poor form!?」

35:5140.en: 「No need to worry!\n$$アポロ$$, focus on the battle!」

35:5187.en: 「$$アポロ$$, stay calm!\nThis is an attack we can read!」

35:5240.en: 「Don't lose your composure!\nWe haven't lost our chance to win!」

35:5324.en: 「Enough, $$アポロ$$! Not all are as tough as you!」

35:5393.en: 「I won't allow insults to my sister!!」

35:5435.en: 「$$アポロ$$, take it! Take my power!」

35:5507.en: 「So every world is about the same!」

35:5606.en: 「If you're coming at me,\nI'll take you on!」

35:5655.en: 「Here goes...!\nThis is the power of $$アクエリオン$$!」

35:5704.en: 「Let's show them...!\nThe power of $$アクエリオン$$!」

35:5860.en: 「Something inside me starts aching\nwhen I look at that one...!」

35:5958.en: 「Ties from the distant past...!\nI'll settle them here!」

35:6013.en: 「This $$アクエリオン$$ will avenge the\n$$天翅$$s' wrath and hatred!」

35:6109.en: 「Can a selfish punk like you\ncarry the world on his back?!」

35:6255.en: 「I won't let you have a say\nin how we live!」

35:6308.en: 「We live because we want to live!」

35:6345.en: 「I'll punch you out and end it all!」

35:6502.en: 「Free dark and light in my soul...!」

35:6625.en: 「The power of life...! I'll show you!」

35:6842.en: 「What the hell! Quitting here!? I'm not full yet!」

35:6923.en: 「Hah! Not from a dopey brute princess!」

35:6970.en: 「Nor from $$シリウス$$, the nervous resetter!」

35:7033.en: 「Everyone, play however you like. I'm still hungry... Later!」

35:7130.en: 「Oh, a break? I'm getting hungry too, perfect.」

35:7183.en: 「Can't play on an empty stomach. Let's fight again after we eat.」

35:7250.en: 「Later! You eat plenty of good food too!」

35:7516.en: 「I lend you my strength! Go, $$アポロ$$!」

35:7547.en: 「I'll take a good look at your power!」

35:7787.en: 「This much is no problem at all!」

35:7820.en: 「$$アポロ$$, don't take any more hits!」

35:7878.en: 「$$アポロ$$, is that all you've got!」

35:7954.en: 「It's needed to win the coming battles. Let's start, $$アポロ$$.」

35:8211.en: 「Show me how strong\nyour power really is!」

35:8262.en: 「I'll eat, eat, and keep on eating!」

35:8293.en: 「We can fly, as long as it's us...!」

35:8532.en: 「$$シリウス$$, $$シルヴィア$$, lend me your power!」

35:8730.en: 「No scent at all from this thing...!?」

35:8771.en: 「I won't let you remake the world!」

35:8835.en: 「They give off only a foul scent...!」

35:8876.en: 「Woman or not, I won't go easy!」

35:8940.en: 「This scent again?! I'm sick of it!」

35:9061.en: 「If you come at me, I have to fight!」

35:9296.en: 「Like hell I'll lose to a calamity!」

35:9426.en: 「$$ミカゲ$$!\nAim all your hatred at me alone!」

35:9481.en: 「Keep others out of your darkness,\n$$ミカゲ$$!」

35:9577.en: 「I'll teach you what a human is!」

35:9614.en: 「This fake stench is killing my nose!」

35:9653.en: 「Don't push your selfish logic on me!」

35:9766.en: 「Get back to your own planet already!」

35:9801.en: 「A $$スフィア$$ holder...!\nHeh, now this is interesting!」

35:9852.en: 「When it comes to crazy power,\n$$アクエリオン$$ is no slouch!」

35:9911.en: 「A scorpion, huh...!\nI'll eat it, venom and all!」

35:9960.en: 「All bones, so there's not much\nto sink my teeth into...!」

35:10087.en: 「Their boss? Then I'll take you down!」

35:10196.en: 「$$アサキム$$! Don't you dare show up!」

35:10239.en: 「Like hell I'll do\nwhat you tell me!!」

35:10288.en: 「Emissary of God or not,\nan enemy gets blasted!」

35:10382.en: 「You've no right to condemn\nthe whole of humanity!」

35:10435.en: 「If you want to play that bad,\nI'll take you on!」

35:10584.en: 「If you're so great,\nfight with just your own strength!」

35:10645.en: 「You've got a nice scent!\nBut I don't like it!」

35:10706.en: 「We and the world haven't fallen\nso low that you'd save us!」

35:10769.en: 「And then... on to a new path!」

35:10844.en: 「I'm here to deliver what you forgot!」

35:10871.en: 「Naturally, I hit back when I'm hit!」

35:10931.en: 「It's still too early to go home!」

35:10962.en: 「Okay, $$アマタ$$! Leave the rest to me!」

35:11024.en: 「Let's see if you dug a good hole!」

35:11162.en: 「$$ジン$$!\nI saw that drive of yours!」

35:11310.en: 「This is no time to be embarrassed,\n$$ユノハ$$!」

35:11464.en: 「Heh, that's not like you, $$カイエン$$.」

35:11495.en: 「Too distracted by the hole, $$アンディ$$!」

35:11766.en: 「I said quit the delusions, $$サザンカ$$!」

35:12045.en: 「Don't whine if you get no share!」

35:12144.en: 「Damn you, quit hiding and come out!」

35:12324.en: 「Weren't you out for revenge on me,\n$$ミカゲ$$?」

35:12373.en: 「You won't beat me with darkness\nand hatred and the like!」

35:12455.en: 「Put some more guts into your attack!」

35:12488.en: 「If that's all the power you've got,\ndon't come at me!」

35:12541.en: 「The smell just fooled me! Not again!」

35:12642.en: 「Don't let your guard down, $$シルヴィア$$!」

35:12912.en: 「Like hell I'll lose to\nthat guy's grudge!」

35:12961.en: 「I'll blast your hatred\naway from right here!」

35:13057.en: 「I'm an idiot to the core!\nI won't give up!」

35:13112.en: 「After seeing an attack like that,\nI can't just keep quiet!」

35:13214.en: 「I... I won't let anyone else die!」

35:13331.en: 「Huh? Training now? I'm not putting up with that.」

35:13396.en: 「Then do it alone. Training topic: 'Read the ending message with your fusion face.'」

35:13562.en: 「Here goes! This is $$アクエリオン$$'s power!」

35:13624.en: 「I'll show you $$アクエリオン$$'s true power!」
